rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. Although it looked up the user, it executed a return without first confirming the order and items with the user, violating the confirm-before-write rule. It refunded to PayPal despite the user explicitly requesting an Amex refund. It also failed to provide the requested tracking number and did not clearly identify/confirm which order was sent to Texas. These errors mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
